user_story: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking that does not exist to return a not-found error so that I know the ID is invalid.

positive.title: Retrieve existing booking successfully
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page as a guest.
Input a valid booking ID that exists in the system.
Submit the request to retrieve the booking.
positive.expected_result: The existing booking details are displayed successfully.

negative.title: Retrieve non-existing booking to return not-found error
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page as a guest.
Input a booking ID that does not exist in the system.
Submit the request to retrieve the booking.
negative.expected_result: A not-found error message is displayed indicating the booking ID is invalid.

edge.title: Retrieve booking with empty ID
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page as a guest.
Leave the booking ID field empty.
Submit the request to retrieve the booking.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking ID cannot be empty.

edge.title: Retrieve booking with special characters in ID
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page as a guest.
Input a booking ID containing special characters (e.g., ‘@!#’).
Submit the request to retrieve the booking.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking ID format is invalid.
